decision.rationale: The long-schedule DCN seeds (42-43) produced the highest NDCG@10 (~0.8379); adding seed 44 is a bounded, controlled replication to estimate robustness and reduce selection-by-chance risk. It directly targets the top-performing configuration without introducing confounding changes to data or loss.
decision.reflection: If seed 44 matches prior results, we gain confidence in reproducibility; if it diverges, it reveals seed sensitivity requiring more seeds or aggregation.
